DEFECT line 56: longestPaymentStatusLength() regex ^\s*([A-Z_]+)\s*[,;(] only matches the FIRST constant on the enum line, so it returns 7 (PENDING) instead of 18 (PARTIALLY_REFUNDED). The test therefore cannot fail for a too narrow status column: changelog-001-payments.yaml declares payments.status and payment_events.status as varchar(16) while PaymentStatus.PARTIALLY_REFUNDED needs 18 characters. The contract the test claims to enforce is never enforced.

DEFECT lines 545-575: render_capacity_report hardcodes the verdict "**No.**" for "Does the recorded run still bind to the current source" and unconditionally demands a full sweep re-run; the computed binding["binds_to_current_source"] is never consulted. The recorded state (production-audit/state/performance-baselines.json -> capacity_limit.binding.binds_to_current_source) is true with an empty reason, yet the generated report production-audit/runs/run-20261118-a2b6e6fc/load-results/capacity-limit.md lines 91-101 state "**No.**", "- Reason: ." and demand a repeated sweep. The report states a false conclusion.

DEFECT lines 570-571: the wire Recorder HTTP server is started and never released. run_acceptance has no try/finally and never calls recorder.stop(), although Recorder exposes stop() and __exit__ for that purpose. The listening socket on port 12113 and its daemon thread stay bound for the rest of the process, the two BLOCKED early returns (lines 597 and 603) leak it as well, and a second acceptance run in the same process fails with address already in use.
